subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Lesson 5: Vocabulary and Grammar – Geography & Past perfect
outcomes: Use the Past perfect: had + past participle.
Put two past events in the right order.

tf.s: A valley is a low place between hills or mountains.
tf.why: Yes! A valley lies low between hills.

tf.s: Sunset is when the sun comes up in the morning.
tf.why: Sunset is when the sun goes down; sunrise is in the morning.

tf.s: A wood is a small forest.
tf.why: Right, a wood is a small area of trees.

tf.s: Salalah is in the north of Oman.
tf.why: Salalah is in the south of Oman.

tf.s: Sur is in the east of Oman.
tf.why: Correct, Sur is in the east.

tf.s: We form the Past perfect with had + past participle.
tf.why: Well done: had + past participle, e.g. had eaten.

tf.s: The Past perfect shows the later of two past events.
tf.why: It shows the earlier event, the one that happened first.

tf.s: The tide is the movement of the sea up and down.
tf.why: Yes, the moon causes the tide.

tf.s: In 'After I had eaten breakfast, I came to school', I came to school first.
tf.why: The Past perfect part, eating breakfast, happened first.

tf.s: A bay is a part of the sea with land curving around it.
tf.why: Good! A bay is where the coast curves in.

boxes.q: What do we call a small forest?
boxes.why: A wood is a small forest.

boxes.q: When does the sun go down?
boxes.why: The sun goes down at sunset.

boxes.q: Complete: She ___ her homework before dinner.
boxes.why: Past perfect = had + past participle: had finished.

boxes.q: Which word means the view of the natural land around you?
boxes.why: Scenery is the beautiful view of nature.

boxes.q: Which direction is opposite to east?
Complete: They ___ (not get) very far before Hussain stopped.
boxes.why: The negative Past perfect is hadn't + past participle.

boxes.q: What is an open area of grass, often on a farm?
boxes.why: A field is an open area of land with grass or crops.

boxes.q: Complete: On the coach I saw that I ___ my money at home.
boxes.why: Leaving the money happened first, so we use had left.

boxes.q: Which word goes with the moon and the sea?
boxes.why: The moon moves the sea up and down: the tide.

boxes.q: You can watch the ___ early in the morning.
boxes.why: The sun comes up at sunrise.

mcq.q: How do we form the Past perfect?
mcq.why: The Past perfect always uses had + past participle.

mcq.q: Which word means the time when the sun comes up?
mcq.why: Sunrise is in the early morning.

o: part of the sea with land curving round it
mcq.why: A bay is where the coastline curves in.

mcq.q: In which part of Oman is Sur?
mcq.why: Sur is in the east of Oman.

o: After they had crossed the valley, they climbed the hill.
After they climbed the hill, they had crossed the valley.
After they have crossed the valley, they climb the hill.
After they had cross the valley, they climbed the hill.
mcq.why: Crossing the valley came first, so it takes the Past perfect.

mcq.q: Complete: Before the sun came up, we ___ and got dressed.
mcq.why: Getting up happened first: had got up.

mcq.q: Join: He brushed his teeth. Then he put on his pyjamas.
o: Before he put on his pyjamas, he had brushed his teeth.
Before he had put on his pyjamas, he brushed his teeth.
After he put on his pyjamas, he had brushed his teeth.
Before he puts on his pyjamas, he brushed his teeth.
mcq.why: Brushing his teeth was first, so it is in the Past perfect.

mcq.q: 'After Muneera had eaten breakfast, she went hiking.' What happened first?
mcq.why: The Past perfect (had eaten) shows the first event.

mcq.q: Ali describes his town: 'The sea comes in and goes out twice a day.' Which word is he describing?
mcq.why: The sea moving in and out is the tide.

mcq.q: Why do we use 'had left' in 'I saw that I had left my money at home'?
o: Leaving the money happened before seeing it.
mcq.why: The Past perfect shows the earlier past action.
